items.title: Earl Foster Interview
items.q: Put a bunch of guys in the band... seeing me... we played there two more weeks... stayed at that place five years.

ctx.x: That's right. That's right. Yeah, Fajro was. That's right, Fajro. That's right. That's the Marrero's. Right. When we played the Coconut Grove, we didn't open it up, but we went there to Hilgert and Boyce, you know. And this Junior Seymour, he came to the Avenue Lawrence, you know. Put a bunch of guys in the band and he told his brother and he had a place over in Marrero who would like for us to come over and play for him. He'd take a life to the band, you know. And then the next day he was over here and seeing…
